newsitem.title: USA: Moody's cuts L.A. Redevelopment Bunker Hill to Ba.
newsitem.headline: Moody's cuts L.A. Redevelopment Bunker Hill to Ba.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it cut its rating to Ba from Baa1 for the Los Angeles Community Redevelopment Agency's Bunker Hill Project.

"The significant erosion of taxable valuation within the Bunker Hill Project area has resulted in a shortfall of pledged tax increment revenues needed to meet debt service requirements," Moody's said.

Based on fiscal 1997 incremental assessed valuation, incremental revenues will provide only 94 percent of the revenues needed to meet debt service requirements on the project area's bonds (a shortfall of approximately $2 million).
In addition, the agency anticipates that it will be required to pay almost $4 million of taxpayer refunds in fiscal 1997.
